answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be grounded in deterministic failure containment: each agent must harbor a hardware-bound attestation key whose opal-style tamper-evident seal anchors a unique physical root, preventing cheap identity replication. A rotating cipher challenge binds every transaction to a fresh proof-of-possession, so colluders cannot reuse one. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
